emma_finance: Invoice 68277 from AcmeHealth (private deploy) has an unexpected net charge. Procurement is asking why.

raj_sales: What lines?

emma_finance: Private license $120,000; Platform fee $30,000; Support prorate $4,500; Usage overage $7,200; PLATFORM-BURST-ADJ credit -$6,000. Net +$1,200 above renewal.

marta_revops: Ops shows auto-scale during bulk import (ops-bot event). Sales verbally approved a concession but no credit memo posted.

ops-bot: Alert: dedicated pool peaked 118% for 3h15m on 2025-10-03. job-id: import-acme-20251003.

support_agent: Customer says the spike was caused during Redwood onboarding and requests reversal.

emma_finance: Recommend partial concession: 70% of overage ($5,040) contingent on signed PO amendment acknowledging split responsibility.

raj_sales: I'll get the addendum signed within 48h. Sales ok to proceed on that basis.

lex_billing: After signed PO + RevOps logs, billing will issue credit memo $5,040 (GL 4202) with description "Onboarding migration overage concession, 70%" and link to invoice 68277. Will hold until docs in FIN-2501.

marta_revops: I'll attach ops logs and support thread to FIN-2501.

emma_finance: Approved conditional on docs. Marking pending. :white_check_mark:
